faqs.question: Are Facebook leads lower quality than Google leads?
faqs.answer: They have different intent. Google captures active demand, while Facebook generates passive demand. Facebook leads require faster follow-up and better sales skills from your front desk, but the cost-per-lead is much lower.

faqs.question: Do we need a big discount to run Facebook ads?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily, but strong "hooks" are required. While low-cost exams work well for volume, we also successfully run high-ticket campaigns (like Implants) focusing purely on authority and financing options.

faqs.question: Can you use our before-and-after photos?
faqs.answer: Yes, but they must be extremely high quality and comply with Meta's aggressive health advertising policies to avoid account bans.

faqs.question: How do you target our specific area?
faqs.answer: We utilize strict geofencing, typically targeting a 5 to 10-mile radius around your physical California practice location.

faqs.question: Do you respond to the comments on our ads?
faqs.answer: Yes, our team actively moderates the ad comments to answer basic questions, hide spam, and protect your brand reputation.
